brash.label: Brash
brash.text: Fights harder in a close-range body (melee frame or arms).

calm.label: Calm
calm.text: Steadier when built to guard others (guardian frame or arms).

stubborn.label: Stubborn
stubborn.text: Likes a heavy body that will not budge (heavy frame, arms or legs).

curious.label: Curious
curious.text: Livelier in a frame it did not use in its last battle.

patient.label: Patient
patient.text: Gathers itself in the back row before it acts.

loyal.label: Loyal
loyal.text: Steadier beside an ally it fought with in its last battle.

restless.label: Restless
restless.text: Livelier in a golem built differently from its last battle (any part changed).

spirits.name: Pyra
spirits.title: the Emberling
spirits.description: A quick-tempered ember who wants to be where the sparks fly.

trait.name: Kindle
trait.text: Her attacks set the target Burning (+1 stack).

awakening.name: Wildfire
awakening.text: When she defeats an enemy, every remaining enemy catches Burn (+1 stack).

spirits.name: Neris
spirits.title: the Calm Tide
spirits.description: Patient and watchful. Pressure only makes her tide rise.

trait.name: Tide Memory
trait.text: When struck, gains Ward equal to her RES (once between her turns).

awakening.name: Floodwall
awakening.text: The first time her HP falls below half, she and every ally gain Ward equal to her RES.

spirits.name: Odo
spirits.title: the Gravemind
spirits.description: An old stone spirit. Slow to move, slower to fall.

trait.name: Bedrock
trait.text: +3 DEF and +3 RES while standing in the front row.

awakening.name: Rumble
awakening.text: Every blow he takes fills his action gauge by 20: the harder he is pressed, the sooner he answers.

spirits.name: Sefa
spirits.title: the Zephra
spirits.description: A restless squall that wants to try every body once.

trait.name: Squall
trait.text: Her attacks leave the target Soaked for 2 turns.

awakening.name: Tailwind
awakening.text: After each of her attacks, every ally's action gauge fills by 12.

spirits.name: Volta
spirits.title: the Sparkwright
spirits.description: A crackling spark who waits for the perfect moment, then strikes twice.

trait.name: Conduction
trait.text: Her hits on a Soaked enemy jolt it again for half her MAG.

awakening.name: Overcharge
awakening.text: Her hits on a Soaked enemy also Stun it (once every 3 of her turns).

spirits.name: Briar
spirits.title: the Thornheart
spirits.description: A bramble spirit that grew around a fallen friend's vessel. Slow to trust; never lets go.

trait.name: Thorns
trait.text: When struck by an attack, lashes the attacker for 2 plus half her DEF.

awakening.name: Bloom
awakening.text: The first time her HP falls below half, she and every ally gain Regen for 3 turns.

spirits.name: Vesper
spirits.title: the Crucible Spirit
spirits.description: Forged from the echoes of defeated champions. It has no home material and takes a little of whatever body it wears.

trait.name: Adaptation
trait.text: Takes a modest bonus from its frame: Bulwark DEF +2 RES +1, Strider STR +2 SPD +1, Conduit MAG +2 SPD +1, Colossus HP +9 STR +1.

awakening.name: Champions' Echo
awakening.text: When an ally falls, Vesper takes up its echo: it surges forward (+40 gauge) and gains Ward of 4 plus half its RES.

wild.name: Moss Wisp
wild.title: the Mossling
wild.description: A soft green glow that gathers wherever stone has been left alone too long.

trait.name: Mossback
trait.text: The first time its HP falls below half, it heals 6.

awakening.name: Spore Cloud
awakening.text: As battle begins, it and every ally gain Regen for 2 turns.

wild.name: Rubble Imp
wild.title: the Pebblekin
wild.description: A grumbling heap of gravel that has never once been talked out of anything.

trait.name: Grit
trait.text: +2 DEF while standing in the front row.

awakening.name: Rockslide
awakening.text: The first time its HP falls below half, it gains Ward equal to its DEF.

wild.name: Brine Sprite
wild.title: the Saltspray
wild.description: A splash of sea that wandered inland and keeps asking where the tide went.

trait.name: Spray
trait.text: Its attacks leave the target Soaked for 2 turns.

awakening.name: Undertow
awakening.text: Its hits on a Soaked enemy drag its action gauge back by 15.

wild.name: Cinder Mote
wild.title: the Flicker
wild.description: A spark that burns brightest just before it gutters out.

trait.name: Kindle
trait.text: Its attacks set the target Burning (+1 stack).

awakening.name: Flashpoint
awakening.text: The first time its HP falls below half, every enemy catches Burn (+1 stack).

wild.name: Root Warden
wild.title: the Old Growth
wild.description: The ruins' ancient keeper. It does not forgive easily, but it remembers who stood beside it.

trait.name: Overgrowth
trait.text: Heals 5 HP at the start of each of its turns.

awakening.name: Deep Roots
awakening.text: As battle begins, it draws every blow to itself (Taunt for 2 turns).

wild.name: Bog Lurker
wild.title: the Mirefoot
wild.description: A patient lump of marsh that only moves when it wants to, which is rarely.

trait.name: Clinging Mud
trait.text: Whoever strikes it comes away Soaked for 2 turns.

awakening.name: Sinkhole
awakening.text: When struck, it drags the attacker's action gauge back by 10 (once between its turns).

wild.name: Spark Newt
wild.title: the Skitter
wild.description: Quick, bright and never in the same place twice.

trait.name: Arc
trait.text: Its attacks leap on to a second enemy for 40% damage.

awakening.name: Static Skin
awakening.text: Whoever strikes it takes 2 plus a quarter of its MAG.

wild.name: Reed Sprite
wild.title: the Whistler
wild.description: Hums through hollow reeds. The fen grows quieter when it sings.

trait.name: Reedbed
trait.text: Starts each battle with Regen (3 turns).

awakening.name: Reed Song
awakening.text: At the start of each of its turns, mends the most wounded ally for 2 plus a quarter of its MAG.

wild.name: Fen Mother
wild.title: the Drowned Matron
wild.description: The fen's old mother. She guards whatever she decides is hers.

trait.name: Tidecaller
trait.text: Soaks every enemy as battle begins and mends 4 HP at the start of each of its turns.

awakening.name: Mourning Tide
awakening.text: When an ally falls, she and every ally gain Ward equal to her RES.

wild.name: Ash Hound
wild.title: the Cinderpup
wild.description: Runs with the pack, and the pack is whoever fed it last.

trait.name: Pack Hunter
trait.text: Each time it is struck, its next turn comes sooner.

awakening.name: Pack Howl
awakening.text: When it defeats an enemy, every ally's action gauge fills by 20.

wild.name: Dust Devil
wild.title: the Whirl
wild.description: A spinning column of grit that cannot sit still.

trait.name: Tailwind
trait.text: Its attacks hurry its allies along.

awakening.name: Grit Storm
awakening.text: Its hits leave the target Weakened for 1 turn (every 2 of its turns).

wild.name: Slag Brute
wild.title: the Slagheap
wild.description: Cooled lava with a temper that never quite did.

trait.name: Slag Hide
trait.text: Strikes back for 2 + half its DEF whenever it is hit.

awakening.name: Molten Core
awakening.text: The first time its HP falls below half, it mends 4 plus its DEF.

wild.name: Kiln Tyrant
wild.title: the Forgelord
wild.description: Lord of the Great Kiln, who melts down whatever it cannot rule.

trait.name: Forgeheart
trait.text: Its attacks set the target Burning, and anyone who strikes it catches Burn too.

awakening.name: Crucible
awakening.text: When it defeats an enemy, it mends 6 plus half its STR.

wild.name: Frost Wisp
wild.title: the Rimelight
wild.description: A cold light that drifts over snowfields and waits for travellers to tire.

trait.name: Deep Chill
trait.text: Its attacks freeze a Soaked target solid for a turn (every 3 turns).

awakening.name: Hoarfrost
awakening.text: Its hits leave the target Soaked for 1 turn (every 2 of its turns).

wild.name: Gale Kite
wild.title: the Updraft
wild.description: Rides the first gust of any fight and is gone before the second.

trait.name: Updraft
trait.text: Bursts ahead of everyone as battle begins.

awakening.name: Slipstream
awakening.text: When it defeats an enemy, its action gauge fills by 40.

wild.name: Rime Ogre
wild.title: the Frostback
wild.description: Huge, slow and kind, in a glacial sort of way.

trait.name: Frost Ward
trait.text: When struck, wraps itself in a ward worth its RES.

awakening.name: Glacial Guard
awakening.text: When an ally falls, it draws every blow to itself (Taunt for 2 turns).

wild.name: Crag Sovereign
wild.title: the Mountain King
wild.description: The White Crag's ruler. It has outlasted every storm and every challenger.

trait.name: Avalanche Mantle
trait.text: Draws every blow as battle begins and, when worn down, wards its whole team.

awakening.name: Landslide
awakening.text: Its hits leave the target Exposed for 2 turns (every 2 of its turns).

wild.name: Storm Hawk
wild.title: the Talon
wild.description: Strikes from above and is climbing again before the thunder.

trait.name: Dive
trait.text: Each time it is struck, its next turn comes sooner.

awakening.name: Stoop
awakening.text: Its hits on a Soaked or Exposed enemy strike again for 2 plus half its STR.

wild.name: Volt Shade
wild.title: the Afterimage
wild.description: A flicker at the edge of sight that is never quite where it seems.

trait.name: Conduction
trait.text: Its attacks deal half its MAG again to a Soaked target.

awakening.name: Afterimage
awakening.text: Once a battle, a blow that would destroy it leaves it standing with a quarter of its HP.

wild.name: Thunder Drake
wild.title: the Stormscale
wild.description: An old drake of the high peaks that guards its flight like family.

trait.name: Forked Strike
trait.text: Against a Burning or Soaked target, its attacks leap on to a second enemy for 50%.

awakening.name: Static Field
awakening.text: As battle begins, every enemy is Exposed until its first turn.

wild.name: Storm Sovereign
wild.title: the Crowned Tempest
wild.description: The storm that sits on the Crown. It answers only to someone who has never lost a vessel.

trait.name: Eye of the Storm
trait.text: Hurries its whole team as battle begins, and its attacks leap on to a second enemy for 40%.

awakening.name: Tempest Crown
awakening.text: When it defeats an enemy, every remaining enemy is Soaked for 2 turns.
